name: adv_variant_require_unknown_param_rejected
source:
// A VARIANT REQUIREs a name that is not a PARAM of the component at all.
COMPONENT Bad(in, out)
  PARAM a, model$ = only
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.h    = in.h
  VARIANT only REQUIRE a, ghost
    out.P = in.P - a
  END
END
Source SRC(f1, fluid$ = Water, mdot = 1.0, P = 400000, T = 300)
Bad    BD(f1, f2, a = 100)
Sink   SK(f2)
p2 = f2.P

error.message: Component 'bd' (bad): parameter 'ghost' has no value (give it a default or pass ghost=value). (required by the selected 'only' variant).
